remarks: Pristine Classic Westport Colonial thoughtfully updated to accommodate today's lifestyle. Home offers a gracious Living Room/Fpl/dining area, Six spacious Bedrooms plus 22x 28 Bonus room. Two bedrooms plus full bath on main Level. 16 x 23 Primary Bedroom plus 3 generous bedrooms on upper level. This level serviced by luxurious updated Full Bath. Kitchen is appointed with upscale appliances including 2025 Refrigerator and red oak flooring. Flexible Room 22x28/half bath can fulfill whatever your needs- in law, office family room all possibilities. Situated on private cul de sac ($500 annual contribution-no formal assoc)on.37 acre in heart of Westport. Shopping, restuarants, beaches, town owned Longshore CC and train all just minutes away.
